chapters.title: Neurons, Glia & Neural Communication
chapters.description: Explore the cellular foundations of the nervous system: neuronal anatomy, glial support, ion channels, resting membrane potential, action potentials, and synaptic transmission.

chapters.title: Functional Neuroanatomy & Nervous System Organization
chapters.description: Map the central and peripheral nervous systems, the autonomic fight-or-flight networks, protective meninges and ventricles, the spinal cord, and brainstem vital centers.

chapters.title: The Forebrain: Subcortical Systems & The Cerebral Cortex
chapters.description: Investigate the diencephalon, limbic emotional circuits, basal ganglia motor loops, and the specialized functions of the four cerebral lobes.

chapters.title: Neuroplasticity, Brain Lateralization & Split-Brain Research
chapters.description: Discover hemispheric specialization through split-brain studies, structural vs. functional plasticity, Hebbian synaptic remodeling (LTP), and adult neurogenesis.

chapters.title: Sensory & Motor Systems: From Physical Stimulus to Perception
chapters.description: Trace sensory transduction and dual visual pathways (what vs. where), auditory mapping, somatosensation and pain gating, and motor hierarchy pathways.

chapters.title: The Endocrine System, Circadian Rhythms & Sleep Neurobiology
chapters.description: Examine hormonal signaling, the HPA stress axis, suprachiasmatic circadian pacemaking, NREM/REM sleep cycles, and glymphatic waste clearance.

chapters.title: Research Methods in Cognitive Neuroscience
chapters.description: Master structural and functional neuroimaging (MRI, fMRI, PET), electrophysiology (EEG, ERPs, MEG), and causal interventions (TMS, lesions, optogenetics).

chapters.title: The Biology of Emotion, Motivation, Stress & Psychopathology
chapters.description: Unpack the mesolimbic dopamine reward pathway, cortisol neurotoxicity, biological models of depression and schizophrenia, and future neural frontiers.
